'''Eric Field''' (also published as '''Eric Fields''') was the alternate of Dark Force Rising, a Star Wars CCG team with [[Paul Todd Feldman]], [[Jeff Davis]], [[Jeff Field]] and [[Dan Hammond]]. [[Torch Industries]] listed the team.<ref name="rising">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/rising.html Dark Force Rising], Paul Todd Feldman. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19991022071037/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/rising.html Internet Archive]</ref> He played at [[2000 BayCon tournament]] on 27 May 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d829">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-baycon-2000-5-27d829/ baycon-2000-5-27], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 4 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-04-baycon-2000-5-27d829/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
